en.text:
Upon readying the weapon after scoring Kills with your other Weapons:
<title Refills [G_refill] /> and/or overfills the Magazine from reserves based on the amount of Weapon Kills scored.

Maximum total overfill amount is 200% of the Magazine Capacity. Each activation can only load up to 100% of the Magazine Capacity into the magazine.

Loaded ammo per Kill by ammo type (rounds up):
• <primary/>Primary Weapons: #e${10+#d}% of Magazine Capacity
• <special/>Special and <heavy/>Power Weapons: #e${20+#d}%

enhanced (
var d = 2.5
#e Loaded ammo per Kill is increased by 2.5% of the Magazine Capacity (e.g. 10%⁠🠚⁠12.5%).
)
